title: Store connections
intro: Connect Shopify or WooCommerce to answer order questions and sync products daily.
privacy: Order details are shared only when the order phone matches the customer's verified WhatsApp number. Website visitors must contact your team. Product prices and stock are dated snapshots.
loadError: Could not load stores. Refresh to try again.
actionError: Could not complete the action. Check your connection and credentials, then retry.
readOnly: I configured these credentials with read-only permissions.
shopifyHelp: Use your permanent myshopify.com address. Grant read_orders and read_products only. Shopify's order-history and customer-data access limits apply.
wooHelp: Use a WooCommerce v3 Read key with access to orders, products and the currency setting. Core WooCommerce tracking data is unavailable.
disconnectPrompt: Disconnect this store and delete its synced product knowledge?
syncError: The connection test or sync failed. Check permissions and credentials. Large catalogues may exceed the documented limits. The last successful snapshot is kept until disconnect.
